article.title: Multidimensional Effects of Telemedicine on Patients With Spinal Cord Injury: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
article.authors: Zhong W, Huang L, Sun X
article.abstract: Spinal cord injury (SCI) causes persistent physical and psychological impairments and is associated with reduced quality of life. Telemedicine may improve rehabilitation access and follow-up care, but its effectiveness across multiple outcome domains in SCI remains uncertain.
